notes:
Bugfixes:

- Strengthens the m3u4u/PVR refresh workflow so IPTV Simple reloads updated playlist data instead of continuing to use stale channel stream URLs after a playlist change.

- Fixes cases where corrected or newly updated channel links, including Redlight HD and OXAX entries, worked in the Custom Site/m3u4u but could still fail in PVR because cached channel data had not been fully refreshed.
